name: PBY Mooring Buoy
blurb: A fixed Hangar-only mooring buoy for flying-boat anchorages, intentionally without articulation or water effects.
history: Flying boats used prepared moorings near seaplane bases and sheltered operating waters. This buoy is an estimated campaign dressing object rather than a claim for one standardized Catalina buoy pattern.

sources.title: United States Coast Pilot, Philippine Islands
